reason: Add bounded pure full LedgerSnapshot transport using original durable canonical frames and original LearningLedger prepare/apply replay.

Full record equality during encode and exact canonical frame equality during decode preserve sequence, predecessor, event bytes/event digest, chain and final head; duplicate/idempotent replay is rejected.
The codec is not trust admission, signature verification, durable writer creation or authority. All host trust/source/task/plan/freeze/contract checks remain required.
No existing ledger algorithms, event encoding, durable file header, dependency, permission, command budget or H process is changed.

limits.frames: unchanged durable_codec::encode_frame; decode_event plus original replay and full canonical frame equality
